classification: Read-only source and binary analysis after review launch; not implementation or accepted runtime coverage
finding: Earlier description of dummy reads as inlined with no emitted symbol was incorrect. Stock xvic emits memmap_mem_read_dummy.isra.0 at RVA0x50840, plus memmap_mem_read.constprop.0 at0x506a0 and .constprop.1 at0x506f0. Exact-name-only symbol matching misses optimized clones.
consequence: Future observation tests and adapters must cover optimized/cloned/inlined paths, not just unsuffixed function entries. Prior bus runtime still lacks regular/dummy read captures; this finding changes planned coverage but does not close that gap.
furtherSourceFacts: mainviccpu.c144-147 calls memmap_mem_update with dummy=1 before _mem_read_tab_ptr_dummy dispatch.
Both normal/dummy store helpers pass write=1 to memmap_mem_update. In its write branch, dummy is not encoded into type; monitor type alone cannot distinguish dummy writes.

The emitted dummy-read helper calls monitor_memmap_store atRVA0x508a3 then loads the actual dummy table entry and tail-jumps through RAX at0x508bf. Its compiled clone remains a callable observation target.
Regular reads have an unsuffixed helper, constant-propagated clones and inline expansions; full CPU-bus capture cannot be claimed from one helper entry.
Table index is computed from original unsigned addr before uint16 dispatch, preserving index256 distinctions.
vic20cpu.c FETCH_OPCODE directly loads packed bytes in the fast path and separately invokes MEMMAP_UPDATE only for reg_pc. Monitor entry events alone are not a complete fetch-byte bus stream.
inference: A common monitor_memmap_store breakpoint plus actual call-site/control-flow observation may cover more paths using fewer hardware slots; not yet implemented, tested or proven complete. Do not infer returned data from peeks or accept monitor type alone for dummy-store classification.
